differentiation_evidence: Six inspected saved PNGs use six distinct causal grammars: dual-critic review bench; dependency lattice to lockfile ledger; source-to-slide provenance arc; figure-eight adaptive document state machine; permission audit machine; and permission-island helpdesk escalation map. Their reading paths, dominant palettes, geometry, hierarchy and annotation patterns are visibly different.
